technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with golden cross and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88, Stoch 94) and weak ADX limit swing entry probability; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of reversal.

fundamental.summary: MGM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 26 days with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market neutral sentiment with slight bearish bias (39.9%) offers no contrarian edge; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (192.3) indicates extreme market stress, and CPI event just occurred; Consumer Discretionary sector highly vulnerable to both macro contraction and credit stress; earnings in 26 days adds event risk but secondary to current environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above all major MAs and new 20-day highs establish strong uptrend structure that could attract momentum continuation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88, Stoch 94), zero fundamental support, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 192.3), and earnings event in 26 days create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Do not enter. Extreme overbought technicals (RSI 88, Stoch 94) combined with zero fundamental support and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) create unacceptable risk-reward despite golden cross structure.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (192.3) and inverted yield curve signal recession risk; Consumer Discretionary sector is highly vulnerable; earnings event in 26 days adds unquantified event risk to already stressed macro backdrop.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction
